verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card product, so receipt capture with OCR and transaction matching is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers rewards, perks, card requests and withdrawals, but never mentions photo or email receipt capture, OCR, or matching receipts to transactions.

support.subject: As an employee, I can snap a photo or forward an email and the platform OCRs the receipt and files it against the right transaction
